Main.Close.RuleChanges: the changes to the rule open in its window, not yet confirmed with Done
Main.Close.Export: the rest of the export that is running: files it has not reached are not exported

Main.Files.Tip: Add files, see which mods run on them, export
Main.Units.Tip: Units and divisions, their stats, weapons and costs, from the game
Main.Undo.Busy: Wait for the run to finish.
Main.Undo.Rules: Undone: a change on the Mods tab.
Main.Undo.Files: Undone: a change to the file list.
Main.Undo.Armory: Undone: a change in the Armory.
Main.Redo.Rules: Redone: a change on the Mods tab.
Main.Redo.Files: Redone: a change to the file list.
Main.Redo.Armory: Redone: a change in the Armory.
Main.Usage.Cpu.What: The app's share of the whole processor, all cores together, as Task Manager shows it.
Main.Usage.Memory.What: Task Manager's Memory column for EasyNDF, split by what the app holds it for. It turns yellow above 900 MB, the aim, and red above 2 GB.
Main.Usage.DotNet.What: What the app's own data took after .NET's last clean-up. When the pauses go above 5%, lag likely comes from memory, not from the work.
Main.Usage.Gpu.What: The graphics card's work for EasyNDF, as Task Manager shows it. The app draws its screens on it. – when Windows doesn't say.
Main.Usage.Disk.What: What the app reads and writes each second: files, pictures, exports.
Main.Usage.UiDelay.What: The longest a click or a key waited before the app got to it. It turns yellow above 100 ms, the aim, and red above 250 ms. Each wait over 100 ms is listed under Slow Moments.
Main.Usage.SlowMoments.None: No slow moments yet. Each time a click or a key waits more than 100 ms, it's listed here.
Main.Usage.SlowMoments.Kept: The last {count} are kept until you clear them or close the app.
Main.Usage.Gesture.Steps: {gesture}: {count} step, slowest {slowest} ms|{gesture}: {count} steps, slowest {slowest} ms
Main.Usage.Copy.Tip: Copy Report: the figures, the last minute, the jobs and the slow moments, as text for a bug report
Main.Usage.Copied: Copied: the figures and {count} slow moment.|Copied: the figures and {count} slow moments.
Main.Usage.Report.Title: EasyNDF {version} usage report, {time} ({windows}, {cores} cores)
